description: The server's current UTC date plus the start of each trailing window (7, 30, 90, 365 days). Call this BEFORE reasoning about dates: a model's idea of 'today' comes from its training data and is routinely months stale, and every other tool here counts backwards from the server's date, not yours. Getting this wrong produces a report confidently labelled with the wrong month.
name: get_current_date
title: Today, and the windows every other tool counts back from
